recommended_path: Retain the approved ST-IG-03 v1.3 architecture and finish the bounded repairs and meaningful proof below. This is a COMPLETE current CP2 review, not a residual-only review or checkpoint/delivery acceptance: all 57 required source paths, all 34 required evidence inputs, the full governing TODO, dispatch/package and frozen bindings were inspected. Immediate source context stayed within the 236-path positive public manifest; exact principal AGENTS/main/profile/Assurance authority governed. Both the 236 source hashes and 42 bound input hashes matched before and after inspection; TODO SHA-256 remained 59026841cbaeff3e363c93729066df5dfb289356fe31d7b2668d0a826890f576. Routing and authority receipts are GO. No tests, runtime/provider operations, private inputs, Git inventory, backups, worktrees, copies, product/TODO changes or active full-API log reads were performed. The stable targeted receipt proves 31 migrations, lint/build, 395 unit passes and 66/70 selected e2e only; it remains diagnostic RED. Independent full-API outcome is deliberately unknown here and must be reconciled by root after both lanes are terminal. Historical CP1 and original ROOT01/03/05/06 and SUBPROTO02/03 closures remain supported; no absent case name or unfinished later checkpoint reopens them. Current code supports the candidate TTL/cancellation/CAS repairs in R1-01, authorization ordering/active-BU and array-body repairs in R1-02, redirect:error in R1-03, the controller portion of R1-04, and the specific MID/message-shape repair in R1-05. ROOT02 now has persisted 40-second deadlines distinct from 60-second leases, current SQL predicates, remaining-time HTTP signals and success/error tuple checks, but its session-after-wait gap remains. ROOT04 now preserves the original CONNECT expectedGeneration/request hash and saves mappedCredentialVersion; completed same-body zero-HTTP replay has an active passing case. Interrupted real-writer replay remains unproved. SUBREC02 now serializes dispatch-history reads and promotion using the resource advisory/identity/channel locks, uses credential-version CAS, and bounds indexed history lookups; the original double-first-POST race is materially repaired, while binding-wide live operation/cooldown semantics and credible concurrent proof remain open. ROOT07 has five explicit safe catalog classifications and transactional audit emissions; its independent complete-API confirmation belongs to root. ROOT08/09 receive clean actual-principal source/hash review here, but their stable-validation reconciliation cannot be closed from an unread parallel run. IG-SUBPROTO-01/IG-SUBREC-03 remain unaccepted. The smallest faithful path keeps the small Instagram HTTP boundary and common MessageAcceptanceService/OutboundService, repairs final live authorization, resource operation ownership, structural preflight and effective-route parser matching, then corrects the four test defects without weakening contracts. The expiry-after-durable-claim case is ACTIVE at residual spec314: 26 main +12 residual +10 identity +20 lifecycle +2 migration cases explain 70 total, with no skip/todo/only markers. The residual file's one failure is the later counter assertion, so its 12-case/one-failure receipt supports a derived pass for the earlier expiry case; absence of an individually printed name is not a skip. The 15-second natural-session pass is explicitly excluded from causal closure because the callback transaction retains Prisma's default five-second timeout. CP3 shared reply/policy and qualified legacy API/Consultar/Typebot boundaries remain unimplemented obligations; current public API and Consultar still project legacy contact/BU.phone. CP4's actual React/operator consumers for OAuth/capabilities/connections/inbox, paginated catalog, disconnect/verify, gateway/CI/browser/freshness are planned, absent and not waived. CP5 ALL/pcv/security/TQA/cutover/final and CP6 separately approved real proof remain mandatory. No backend-only delivery, new WHAT, guessed subscription identity/configuration, retry from UNKNOWN, or admission/application of the session middleware, privacy HTML or 1000-UTF8-byte proposals is granted. Performance remains unmeasured; the resource history existence/index repair is favorable, but later frozen EPS/RLS thresholds are not satisfied by request counters. The recommended repairs improve coherent ownership and reduce inconsistent guard paths without a general framework.

findings.title: Own-account subscription observation remains an unaccepted protocol obligation
findings.rationale: SCOPE-04 and the normative own-account read/read-before-retry criterion remain explicit; the package's authoritative open list overrides erroneous resolved carry-forward labels. instagram-http.client.ts:82-90 still issues a provisional GET and returns null for every successful body. This truthfully preserves UNKNOWN, but establishes neither own presence nor complete own absence. The sealed primary rechecks do not establish GET support, returned ID namespace, own-app visibility or completeness. IG-SUBREC-03 therefore remains open with this ID. No repeated mutation was observed or authorized, and missing documentation does not prove endpoint non-support.
findings.suggested_action: Keep both IDs open through independent CP3 work. Obtain the supported primary observation contract before recovery acceptance, then implement only its documented own identity, required fields and completeness rules. UNKNOWN continues fencing mutation. Add no guessed product/parent-app/account equality, new parent configuration, alternate login, blind retry or unauthorized provider investigation.

findings.title: Signed-session expiry is still checked before database waits instead of at the final mutation and dispatch boundary
findings.rationale: Static current-source defect under SCOPE-04/DOD-03/VAL-03, not a dynamically established exploit. requireActorTx verifies the signed session at service621-622, then awaits app_users FOR SHARE, BU and grant reads at623-630 without checking expiry again. Callers then await resource/channel/attempt locks. The callback claim at115-121 protects attempt/operation clocks, but not the signed session's exp; the first code POST at127 has no new pre-dispatch session check. requireLiveActor at632-638 likewise verifies before awaited user/access reads. Thus a valid session can expire during an otherwise still-live short database wait and admit later work; the newer attempt/deadline SQL does not close this separate clock. Residual spec34-129 waits about15 seconds, while the claim transaction has no timeout override in service113 or PrismaService/helper configuration. The documented default five-second transaction timeout is a plausible independent rollback cause. Its PASS/zeroHTTP is not causal evidence of session revalidation.
findings.suggested_action: Within the admitted authorization owner, retain locked current actor/grant facts and revalidate signed-session expiry using actual time after the last relevant wait, immediately before irreversible dispatch or mutation, and after provider success/error. Keep operation and token-acquisition clocks distinct. First establish a real BFF/PG short-wait RED inside the live transaction budget with exact waiter/blocker evidence and a matched non-expired-session control; then repair and prove zero HTTP/promotion after expiry. Do not raise transaction timeouts merely to manufacture proof or edit the pending protected middleware.

findings.title: Durable first-POST history is shared, but the live subscription lease and cooldown remain attempt-local
findings.rationale: The original resource-history read/first-dispatch race and competing credential overwrite are materially repaired: service278/414/606-615 serialize the same resource, mapping324-325 checks the captured credential version, and429-430 use indexed existence lookups. However, reauthorization mapping276-341 does not reject another attempt's live subscription operation. subscribeAfterMapping436-447 checks only the current attempt's operationLeaseUntil and lastSubscriptionAttemptAt. A held first POST on A can therefore overlap B's same-resource reauthorization promotion and subsequent UNKNOWN GET under B's fresh fields before A's60-second lease/10-second cooldown expires. A's late result is version-fenced, and history prevents a second POST; this is not a demonstrated duplicate mutation. It still fails the approved per-binding lease/cooldown and one-current-holder contract. The current concurrency test966-1035 cannot establish closure: its mapped snapshots999-1002 omit mappedCredentialVersion, so424 rejects both before the expected POST; await postsEntered1022 then times out.
findings.suggested_action: Make new/resumed subscription work and reauthorization promotion participate in one resource/binding operation fence, with shared lease/cooldown admission and current credential CAS, while retaining durable dispatch history across cancel/new attempt/reauthorization/crash. Keep HTTP outside transactions. Repair the synthetic snapshots with their truthful mapped version, make barriers fail promptly on denied requests and always release/restore hooks, and add an actual CONNECT/REAUTHORIZE writer overlap proving one POST, bounded observation and preserved later-holder facts. Do not treat two hand-built mapped rows as proof of the real promotion path.

findings.title: Controller callback failures are protected, but precontroller session failures still retain the sensitive URL
findings.rationale: The admitted controller now sets no-store/no-referrer before validation and catches domain/provider failures into an allowlisted303 at instagram-authorizations.controller.ts:37-54; current tests cover this supported repair. SessionMiddleware still throws for absent/expired/revoked session, mandatory password change, incomplete onboarding or infrastructure error before controller entry, with no callback-specific headers/clean redirect. A code/state-bearing callback can therefore receive an ordinary error on its original URL. The exact v2 companion is reviewed but NOT ADMITTED/NOT APPLIED; proposal closure of IG-OAUTH-SESSCOMP-01 is not source closure of this finding. Gateway/query-log and browser confidentiality remain CP4 obligations.
findings.suggested_action: Retain R1-04 open. After explicit admission of the exact protected-path companion, use the serialized writer to apply and verify it without changing ordinary route/session enforcement. Prove known denials and unexpected precontroller failure at real Nest/PG boundaries, then fixed-text consumer, browser and gateway confidentiality. This review grants no path admission or source-write authority.

findings.title: Whole-batch preflight still permits a supported text update without an entry account identity
findings.rationale: The original MID/message-shape defect has a source repair and active negative assertions. A residual structural hole remains at instagram.controller.ts:37-42: entry.id is optional and an empty string also passes. Supported text messages are validated after flatMap without their owning entry context at44-74. Processing then silently skips a text event whose entry.id is absent at81 and returns EVENT_RECEIVED/200. A batch containing a valid first entry and a later otherwise-supported text entry with no id can commit the first message and acknowledge the lost second update. This static counterexample requires no guessed provider identity and violates CP2-BOUNDS/REPLAY's before-effects structural preflight. It is distinct from the intentional retryable unknown-resource partial-batch path.
findings.suggested_action: Keep supported-event normalization attached to its entry. Before any domain writes, require the bounded nonempty account identity needed by every supported text event and reject a malformed batch. Preserve deliberate valid unsupported/read/echo handling and domain-failure partial commits/replay. Add valid-first plus missing/empty/invalid entry-account cases asserting non-200 and zero effects, without loosening the existing MID or1000-distinct-update assertions.

findings.title: Endpoint-local parser limits do not cover all route spellings accepted by the router
findings.rationale: Static inference from current configuration, not an executed HTTP result. body-parsers.ts:25-31 uses case-sensitive regular expressions ending immediately after the OAuth route and an exact Instagram webhook path. main.ts and the real test bootstrap do not enable strict/case-sensitive Express routing. Express5 treats case variants and trailing-slash variants as the same route under those defaults, as documented in its [application settings](https://expressjs.com/en/5x/api/application/#app.settings.table). An accepted OAuth trailing-slash or case variant can miss the16KiB parser and reach the shared1MiB JSON parser; whitespace-padded otherwise-valid JSON can therefore bypass the declared endpoint limit. An Instagram alias similarly falls back to1MiB instead of the declared8MiB. Current bounds tests use only canonical spellings.
findings.suggested_action: Make the endpoint-specific parser matcher agree with effective routing for these admitted routes, preserving dynamic identifier values and existing WhatsApp parser behavior. Add actual Nest tests for canonical/case/trailing-slash variants, with16KiB OAuth rejection and the same raw-signature/8MiB Instagram behavior. Do not change global routing semantics merely to satisfy this local protection.

findings.title: Interrupted confirmation recovery still lacks proof from the actual writer
findings.rationale: The original CONNECT request-generation defect is supported repaired: mapping331-334 saves mappedCredentialVersion without overwriting expectedGeneration, and completed-result replay227-247 precedes new usability work. Real completed CONNECT replay1125-1152 is active and passing. The failing persisted-snapshot test1073-1123 is synthetic: its update1107-1112 omits mappedCredentialVersion, whereas the actual writer333 saves it. assertMappedSubscriptionResult573 correctly rejects that incomplete snapshot, producing409 at1117; changing the request body or bypassing the version check would be wrong. Making this fixture valid would still not prove actual interruption between committed mapping/subscription and confirmation-result completion. Existing real mapping/deadline cases leave IN_PROGRESS facts but do not resume the original key/body.
findings.suggested_action: Preserve the synthetic snapshot scenario and populate its truthful immutable mapped version. Add a separate real BFF/PG interruption or ACK-loss case after the actual writer commits mapping and before durable result completion, then replay the original CONNECT empty body/key. Assert unchanged credential version/ciphertext, original request hash, one promotion/at-most-one POST, correct result completion and409 for changed bodies. Also prove completed historical replay remains immutable and zeroHTTP after current credential/generation usability changes, subject to current authorization.

findings.rationale: The current reached failure at residual spec501 is a test defect, not evidence that this callback made18 requests or promoted an expired credential. instagramFake.calls is reset once in beforeAll18-29 and accumulates earlier cases. The final filter counts every earlier OAuth/token/profile call but expects3. Assertions493-500 already reached protected303, EXCHANGING, absent candidate key/ciphertext and zero active credentials for the tested BU. The source's final candidate margin predicate at service154 supports that bounded behavior; the RED aggregate still prevents a full-green claim.
findings.suggested_action: Capture the relevant call count or index immediately before this callback and assert exactly its three fixed protocol requests, retaining every confidentiality, candidate and credential assertion. Preserve accumulated history and all prior scenarios; do not globally reset counters to hide calls or lower the expected guarantee. Keep the delayed /me hook and request/body timeout proof distinct.

findings.title: The fourth-request assertion reaches cooldown before the exhausted request-budget predicate
findings.rationale: The current orientation/window test obtains three subscription requests, then immediately invokes advance at cp2 spec648-653. Service437 checks the10-second cooldown before438 checks subscriptionRequests>=3, so429 OPERATION_COOLDOWN is consistent with current admission ordering. This reached result does not prove a fourth request occurred or that the three-request cap failed. The earlier dedicated cooldown and held duplicate assertions are useful. The failure prevents later exact budget-state assertions, cross-attempt reauthorization/cancellation and final partial-batch receipt/account-isolation assertions661-716 from being reached in this run.
findings.suggested_action: Retain both cooldown and exhausted-budget scenarios. For the independent exhaustion probe, establish the required elapsed cooldown in its own real persisted fixture, then require409 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUEST_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, unchanged request/history fields and zero provider delta. Preserve the cap of3 and cooldown10 seconds; do not reorder production checks merely to satisfy a confounded expected status. Restore meaningful execution of every later scenario and ensure HTTP hooks are always released.

findings.title: All sixteen obligation areas are exercised, but complete behavioral proof remains narrower than the claim
findings.rationale: Exact current map: CONFIG has complete/partial and four absent/malformed variants with zero writes/HTTP, but not every webhook/crypto-config variant or service-recreation quota proof. AUTHZ now has broad real session/CSRF/role/cross-tenant/inactive-BU/actor and post-authorization shape coverage; natural-expiry-after-wait remains unproved. IDEMPOTENCY adds twenty fresh creates/audit-once and completed confirm replay; twenty fresh confirmations and actual interrupted replay remain open. CALLBACK covers state/replay/concurrent code CAS, grant/password/cancel/token takeover after success; real expiry within a live DB transaction and corresponding provider-error fences need causal proof. TOKEN/IDENTITY cover mandatory three-step protocol, minimal returned scopes, ambiguous envelope, opaque distinct IDs, short/long failures and margin refusals; the older profile-delay hook at main389 tests pathname==/me although the client uses/v26.0/me, so that old case's named delay does not occur. The later residual487 endsWith('/me') margin case supplies a real delay but ends at the bad accumulated counter. CONFIRM/CANCEL now contain expiry, actual-lock cancellation and competing credential-version assertions; concurrent resource test and writer-recovery fixture remain defective. UNCERTAINTY safely preserves UNKNOWN and durable history, but own observation and per-binding lease/cooldown are open. SIGNATURE now includes wrong purpose and semantically equal/different raw bytes. BOUNDS now proves1000 DISTINCT MIDs/peers with exact message/conversation/route/identity/unread deltas and zero-effect replay, plus8MiB/1001/16KiB limits; effective-route aliases and entry-account preflight are missing. ORIENTATION/WINDOW cover IN/echo/read/reaction, old/future/missing timestamps and residual self/deleted events; the combined main case's later assertions are unreached after652. REPLAY adds twenty concurrent FIRST deliveries with one complete inbox effect; the later partial-batch completion needs a clean reached rerun. RECEIPT has held-POST late success and residual signed receipt plus cancellation/late provider error preserving CANCELLED/messages/unread; this is stronger than R1, but does not replace all lease/generation/credential takeover permutations. SAFE-OUTPUT has safe DTO/ciphertext, controller failure redirects and activity-log checks; precontroller/gateway/browser protection is still pending. These are exact proof gaps, not claims that every untested combination is defective. Current70-case inventory contains no skipped tests; the earlier expiry-after-claim case is not absent simply because the default log lacks its printed name.
findings.suggested_action: Replace reported-complete language with current reached assertions and explicit remaining rows for all16 IDs. Correct the four independent test defects and add causal real-boundary coverage for the source findings, actual writer interruption, fresh confirmation concurrency, expired/replaced success/error holders and HTTP remaining-time/body-read behavior. Fake only the provider boundary; preserve scenarios, source IDs and durable facts. Use finite barriers with reliable cleanup and truthful local deltas. Keep five-wave20-request/resource/ingress stress,10000-conversation EPS/RLS, fifteen-second batch measurement, ALL, browser/freshness and independent TQA/security/cutover/final explicitly assigned to CP4/CP5. This review is not that final TQA gate and does not waive consumers or CP6.
